observational_unit: One harvested plot. Leaves, dates, sensor pixels and article versions are nested measurements, not independent harvests.
environment_unit: Site × harvest year; shared weather and duplicate publications share an independent_environment_group.
minimum_evidence: At least two genuinely independent eligible environments; two is an intake minimum, not enough to establish broad transfer or robust uncertainty.

joins.canopy_disease: Join only verified plot/date/final-leaf-rank records; keep disease identities separate. Different dates require explicit temporal alignment, never a leaf-rank substitution.
joins.harvest: Many dates/leaves to exactly one observed harvest per plot. Aggregate predictors before joining harvest for model fitting.
joins.reference: Predefined affected/reference plots in the same design context. Shared reference plots imply correlated contrasts.
joins.weather: Environment to weather_series_id/date with complete forcing for the supported window; station/reanalysis origin and gaps explicit.

required_units.green_area: m2 green lamina per m2 ground for each measured leaf layer; percentage greenness/lesion scores are not LAI.
required_units.functional_area: Independent function-based measurement or validated observation operator; green tissue does not alone quantify photosynthetic efficiency.
required_units.calendar_HAD: Integral of observed green/functional LAI over calendar days: m2 m-2 day.
required_units.thermal_HAD: Integral over thermal time: m2 m-2 degC day, with base temperature and date origin specified. Coefficients cannot be transferred from calendar HAD.
required_units.yield: Reported values and moisture retained. Multipliers to kg/ha: kg_ha=1, t_ha=1000, dt_ha=100, g_m2=10. Dry yield = reported kg/ha × (1 - reported moisture percent/100). Unknown moisture prevents conversion.
required_units.radiation: Global solar MJ m-2 day-1 distinct from PAR; interception/HAA require justified conversion and leaf-layer coverage.

stage_windows.eligibility: Observed or explicitly justified stage dates and bracketing canopy observations at both window boundaries, per retained leaf layer. Gap and interpolation sensitivity specified before fitting.
unsupported_substitutions: GS83 or generic senescence is not GS85
Anthesis/heading-based thermal integrals do not establish GS31 coverage
stage_windows.failure_action: Report a restricted observed window. No extrapolation across unobserved developmental periods.

comparators: Training-only crop-management and endpoint-severity benchmarks on identical eligible harvests.
Parsimonious stage- and leaf-aware model using actual observed canopy area.
Healthy-area-duration baseline with documented units; reconcile current normalized HAD conversion before any absolute yield comparison.
Crop-growth physiological damage formulation only if crop/weather/soil/initial-state inputs and training observations identify its parameters.
calibration: Protected/reference crop growth and yield calibrated separately from incremental disease-associated loss; disease-free status requires observed evidence. Reserve/sink extensions require measured reserve/biomass/grain-growth constraints.
validation: Lock environment allocations before fitting. Fit preprocessing, imputation and parameter selection within training folds; hold out whole environment groups. Assess protected yield, affected yield, paired absolute difference and relative loss with common grain moisture units.
uncertainty: Cluster by independent environment and preserve shared-reference dependence. Few environments limit transfer and interval interpretation; no plot-level bootstrap masquerading as environmental validation.
attribution: Default to management-package or mixed-disease protection contrast unless measurements and experimental design support STB-specific attribution. Negative contrasts remain.
next_gate: Parent coordination after a concrete eligible raw cohort and join/measurement audit, before expansive modeling.
additional_crop_model_inputs: Model-specific soil layers, hydraulic properties, initial water/N, sowing and nutrient/water operations remain necessary; the generic templates are not a complete WOFOST/DSSAT configuration.
